title: INPHA-MédiS 25th Anniversary
info: INPHA-MédiS celebrated 25 years “au service de la santé”. The anniversary called for an identity that marks the milestone while staying true to the company’s established brand.
The work centres on a “25 years” anniversary mark that sits alongside the INPHA-MédiS logo, carried across print, merchandise, signage and social media throughout the year.

images.alt: INPHA-MédiS 25th anniversary stationery, mugs, calendar and tote bag

value.title: Challenge
paragraphs: An anniversary needs to feel like a celebration without competing with the main brand. The 25-year mark had to sit naturally next to the existing logo and stay consistent across very different touchpoints, from a business card to the front of a building.

images.alt: INPHA-MédiS 25 years banner on a glass office building at dusk

value.title: Solution
paragraphs: The “25 years” mark uses the brand’s own blue and clean, clinical layouts, so it reads as part of INPHA-MédiS rather than a separate campaign.

It was applied to stationery, mugs, calendars, tote bags and large-format building signage, and extended into social media posts for national and health awareness days: 1 November, the International Day of Persons with Disabilities, World Diabetes Day and screening campaigns.
